cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Declare Allegiance
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which person, side, or claim to authority they will support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My ribbon or Nina's for the chess-club election? Please put one on before the candidates arrive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're selecting a chair, not reviewing your friendships. Which candidate are you supporting?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I wear yours today and hers tomorrow?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow is voting day. Start with tomorrow's ribbon, please. We can arrange your social calendar after you've answered the election question.

reason: Make A professionally correct the category of each evasion and use B alternating-day offer to demand decisive public allegiance.
